ops.target: title: A scheduled job fails because the scale-to-zero store is still waking
ops.text: title: A scheduled job fails because its database secret is stale after the store branch reset

ops.target:
The store suspends when idle, and the job is the first client of the night. Resuming the compute
takes longer than the client's 5 s connect timeout, so the first connection fails. By the morning
the store is awake. The error text of the failed connection was not kept.
ops.text: The weekly reset of the store branch issued a new login for the job's role, and the job still held the secret synced a week earlier: its connection was refused in 212 ms with an authentication failure while the compute was awake (raw:20261012T020004Z-7be2c905, issue:fixture-org/inkwell#27).

append_log: Created pattern/job-secret-stale-after-branch-reset (hypothesis) from incident/2026-10-inkwell-digest-job-failed-with-long-timeout and the two records in raw/: the connection was refused in 212 ms on an authentication failure while the store was awake. Set pattern/nightly-job-fails-while-store-wakes to superseded by it; its text is unchanged. Linked the incident to the new pattern. Nothing is confirmed: no deployed red-to-green run exists.
